0.name: Potential
0.short: The infinite starting point — wholeness, beginnings and divine guidance.
0.core: Zero is the circle with no beginning or end. It magnifies every digit it stands beside and signals that a new cycle is opening with unlimited potential.
0.love: Your love life is at a reset point. Single? Clear the slate of old patterns. Committed? A fresh chapter is available if you both choose it.
0.career: A blank canvas: ideal moment to start a project, rebrand, or change direction. Don't carry old limits into the new cycle.
0.money: Money is neutral right now — what you put in multiplies. Build systems, not one-off wins.
0.action: Start the thing. Write the first line, register the name, make the first call.

1.name: New Beginnings
1.short: Initiative, independence and manifesting — your thoughts are becoming reality fast.
1.core: One is the pioneer. It shows up when a door is opening and your thoughts are unusually 'loud' — what you focus on is taking form quickly.
1.love: Lead with clarity. Say what you want out loud. If you're single, a new connection may start from you making the first move.
1.career: Launch energy. Pitch the idea, apply for the role, start the side business. First-mover advantage is real under a 1.
1.money: Fresh income streams favour you. Back one bold, well-researched bet instead of ten timid ones.
1.action: Pick one goal and take the first concrete step within 24 hours.

2.name: Balance & Partnership
2.short: Cooperation, patience and trust — something good is growing quietly.
2.core: Two is the number of pairs and alliances. It asks for patience: seeds you've planted are germinating even if you can't see them yet.
2.love: Harmony and teamwork. Listen more than you speak. A partnership (romantic or business) is asking for commitment and fairness.
2.career: Collaborate. A partner, mentor or co-founder amplifies your results more than going solo right now.
2.money: Joint ventures and shared resources work. Read contracts closely — balance means both sides win.
2.action: Reach out to one person you could build something with.

3.name: Creativity & Expression
3.short: Growth, joy and communication — express yourself and expand.
3.core: Three is the number of expression and expansion. It encourages you to speak, create, publish and let your personality be seen.
3.love: Playfulness and honest conversation revive connection. Singles attract through authenticity, not perfection.
3.career: Content, design, teaching, sales — anything creative or communicative is favoured. Publish, don't polish forever.
3.money: Your ideas are your assets. Monetize a skill or creative output rather than trading only time for money.
3.action: Create and share one piece of work today.

4.name: Foundation & Stability
4.short: Structure, hard work and protection — build it right and it lasts.
4.core: Four is the square: four walls, four seasons, four directions. It says you are supported and that the work you do now becomes a lasting foundation.
4.love: Security and loyalty matter. Build trust through consistency; a stable, grounded partner is favoured.
4.career: Systems, processes, and steady effort pay off. This is the time to build infrastructure, not chase shortcuts.
4.money: Budget, save, and build assets. Slow, compounding moves beat speculation under a 4.
4.action: Fix one weak foundation — a habit, a system, a document you've been avoiding.

5.name: Change & Freedom
5.short: Movement, adventure and transformation — big change is arriving.
5.core: Five sits in the middle of 1–9 and loves motion. It signals change: travel, a new role, a new city or a new mindset. Resisting it costs more than embracing it.
5.love: Excitement and renewal. Try something new together — or, if single, expect someone who shakes up your routine.
5.career: Pivot energy. New markets, new platforms, new skills. Adaptability is your competitive edge.
5.money: Opportunities appear through movement and networking. Take smart risks; keep a cash buffer for surprises.
5.action: Say yes to one change you've been postponing.

6.name: Love & Responsibility
6.short: Home, family, care and harmony — tend to what (and who) matters.
6.core: Six is the nurturer. It points to home, family, service and balance between material and emotional needs.
6.love: Deep, caring energy. Commitment, moving in, family plans or healing an old rift are all highlighted.
6.career: Service-based work, community, health and education thrive. Take care of your team and clients — loyalty follows.
6.money: Balance spending on others with investing in yourself. Home and property matters are favoured.
6.action: Do one generous thing for someone close to you — and one for yourself.

7.name: Wisdom & Inner Knowing
7.short: Intuition, study and spiritual awakening — trust your inner voice.
7.core: Seven is the seeker. It rewards research, reflection and quiet time. You're on the right path and your intuition is sharper than usual.
7.love: Depth over drama. Meaningful conversations and emotional honesty bring you closer.
7.career: Research, analysis, strategy and specialist skills are favoured. Learn something that makes you rare.
7.money: Do the homework before acting. Informed decisions made now pay long-term dividends.
7.action: Block one hour of distraction-free thinking or learning.

8.name: Abundance & Power
8.short: Prosperity, authority and karma — the flow of success is open.
8.core: Eight, the sideways infinity, is the number of material mastery and cause-and-effect. What you've invested is ready to return — multiplied.
8.love: Mature, equal power in relationships. Mutual ambition and respect strengthen bonds.
8.career: Promotions, leadership and business growth. Ask for the raise, set the higher price, close the deal.
8.money: The money number. Abundance is flowing — manage it wisely and it compounds.
8.action: Make one move that increases your income or the value of an asset.

9.name: Completion & Purpose
9.short: Endings, compassion and higher purpose — a chapter is closing.
9.core: Nine is the last single digit — the number of completion. Something is wrapping up so something better can begin. It also points to service and purpose.
9.love: Let go of what's finished. Forgiveness and closure clear space for a healthier connection.
9.career: Finish projects, tie loose ends, and consider work with a bigger mission or global reach.
9.money: Clear debts and declutter commitments. Generosity and giving back create unexpected returns.
9.action: Finish or formally close one lingering thing.
